name: Glimmingen - Bjursjon
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Glimmingen to Bjursjon, on forest path, dirt road and asphalt; no ferry, rowboat or official alternate geometry found; includes protected-area and water-protection subsegments plus strong mid-stage service/access context at Kurod/Skalbanksmuseet

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 13. Glimmingen - Bjursjon
keyFacts: Canonical stage identity is 13. Glimmingen - Bjursjon.
Official WST slug is 13-glimmingen-bjursjon.
Official direction is Glimmingen to Bjursjon.
Official distance is 12 km / 12000 m.
Official estimated time is 5 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.
Surface is forest path, dirt road and asphalt.
Stage is in Uddevalla municipality.
WST says Glimmingen is reachable by car and bus, and the bus stop is Glimmingen.
WST says there are public transport stops near Skalbanksmuseet.
WST says there is no local traffic to Bjursjon, but there is good parking.

Route narrative describes Bavean nedre about 800 m north of Glimmingen, Stora Koperodssjon and its wind shelter, a side-route option toward Uddevalla centre west of Nothult, Skalbankarna/Kurods skalbankar and the approach to Bjursjon.
WST English page has translation/name typos including Burusjon and Skalbanksmusset; Swedish/API names confirm Bjursjon and Skalbanksmuseet.

fire.snapshot: Krisinformation live fire-ban layer queried 2026-04-29 for Uddevalla returned Inget eldningsforbud.
fire.routeRule: Reserve-specific fire rules still apply even without a municipal fire ban, especially Bavean's designated-place-only rule.
fire.confidence: high for query time; low for future dates
caveats: Fire-ban status is volatile; check Krisinformation/rescue service/municipality before publication or trip.
Fyrbodal policy says stricter bans also prohibit fixed public grill sites.

dogs: WST dog guidance: during 1 March-20 August, dogs should be controlled as strictly as on leash, within about one meter.
Kurods skalbankar specifically forbids unleashed dogs.
Bjursjon municipal bathing area forbids dogs; dog bathing may be possible on the northeast shore.
huntingFishingAndLivestock: WST seasonal hunting notice says elk hunting runs 8 Oct-31 Jan in west Swedish forests; specific warnings were listed for Stages 24 and 15, not Stage 13, and 2026-04-29 is outside that season.
Hunting and fishing are not included in allemansratten.
Bjursjon fishing needs no permit per Uddevalla, but this is local to Bjursjon.
wayfinding: Outdooractive and a 2025 field report flag wayfinding risk near Bjursjon/north Uddevalla trail networks.
A 2025 report missed a Bohusleden turn south of Bjursjon where only a trail mark indicated the turn.
Use official WST/Naturkartan geometry and on-ground Bohusleden markings over route-app staging.
seasonalHazards: AllTrails reports wet, slippery or muddy conditions after rain and in winter.
Mixed forest path, dirt road and asphalt surface.
Koperodssjoarna water protection area requires contamination caution.
Forestry work may affect Kurod and Glimmingen/Inskogen in 2026; keep distance from workers/machines.

conditionReports.summary: Official page lists the stage normally as 12 km, blue/medium, 5 h, and status API returned [] with no active deviation exposed.
Visible text entry notes great views and does not report a closure.
Visible text entry says great conditions, free medium parking and not crowded.
Visible report says very wet and slippery.
Visible report says wet after recent rain.

Field report notes Stora Koperodssjon shelter context, rocky ground, a more sheltered clearing about 50 m back, short swampy section on access path, shooting-range noise and a missed Bohusleden turn south of Bjursjon.
Warns that it can be difficult not to lose the right way near the trail network north of Uddevalla, but combines current official Stages 13 and 14.
Reports Bjursjon mowed grass, day users, group accommodation, two portaloos and jetty camping, plus Skalbanksmuseet toilet/tap water and nearby petrol-station drinks.
Older report calls the start of Stage 13 and parts before it tedious due to paved/gravel roads and mediocre visibility/markings.

sources: WST official page/API: 12 km / 12000 m, 5 h.
Naturkartan: 12.0 km, 5 h.
WST/Naturkartan official geometry computes about 11.906 km after de-duplication.
AllTrails lists 10.3 km and 2.5-3 h.
Pacer lists 7.6 mi / about 12.2 km.
sourceContradictions.decision: Use WST official 12 km and 5 h as canonical; store measured official geometry length about 11.906 km; treat route-app distances/times as secondary.

sources: WST GPX/API, Naturkartan API and Naturkartan GPX are exact matches.
OSM relation 1899756 is ordered and continuous but locally diverges up to about 119.79 m and computes about 273 m longer.
sourceContradictions.decision: Use WST/Naturkartan exact geometry as primary and OSM as planning-grade QA only.

sources: WST says no local traffic to Bjursjon.
Vasttrafik/OSM evidence shows fixed-route stops at Kopperods viadukt about 2.1 km away.
Naturkartan transit widget reportedly says no stops found.
sourceContradictions.decision: Model Bjursjon endpoint as parking-focused with no endpoint public transport; include Kopperods viadukt only as a distant nearest fixed-route approach.

sources: Naturkartan embedded transit widget reports no stops found.
WST/Vasttrafik/OSM confirm Glimmingen fixed bus access and Kurod/Skalbanksmuseet nearby stops.
sourceContradictions.decision: Treat Naturkartan transit widget result as stale/widget-limited and use WST/Vasttrafik/OSM for access metadata.

sources: Bohuslans museum operator page says the museum is closed for the season and opens again June 2026.
Uddevalla municipality page published 2026-02-02 reportedly still says the museum opens June 14, 2025.
sourceContradictions.decision: Prefer the Bohuslans museum operator page for 2026 opening status; keep Uddevalla page for attraction context only.

sources: WST narrative says Koperodssjon shelter can be used for rest or overnight.
WST campsite/rest-place category query returned 0.
Bavean nedre bans tents and Kurods skalbankar bans camping.
A 2023 blog describes jetty camping at Bjursjon.
sourceContradictions.decision: Import Koperodssjon as shelter, not formal campsite; do not model Stage 13 as generally tent-friendly or import Bjursjon blog camping as a permitted campsite.

sources: WST dedicated drinking-water category returned 0.
Bjursjostugan and Skalbanksmuseet have conditional/opening-hours or dated tap-water evidence.
Vindskyddskartan says Koperodssjon shelter water quality unknown.
sourceContradictions.decision: Do not mark reliable on-route drinking water; carry water. Treat Bjursjostugan/Skalbanksmuseet as conditional service water and Koperodssjon as natural/unknown-quality water only.

sources: OSM maps a Bavean-area firepit and Koperodssjon shelter has fireplace=yes.
Bavean reserve rule allows fires only at manager-designated places.
Krisinformation reported no general Uddevalla fire ban on 2026-04-29.
sourceContradictions.decision: Keep Bavean OSM-only firepit pending; do not model fire as generally allowed. Use reserve-specific rules and live fire-ban checks.

lanes.summary: Captured WST/Naturkartan identity, facts, route narrative, official GPX/API, WST places, Bavean/Kurods/Bjursjon/Skalbanksmuseet source context and official-stale-risk notes.
Confirmed WST API, WST GPX, Naturkartan API and Naturkartan GPX exact-match geometry; OSM relation 1899756 continuous but QA-only due local 120 m divergence.
Captured Glimmingen, Bavean nedre, Koperodssjon shelter, Skalbanksmuseet, Kurod service hub, Bjursjostugan/Bjursjon and pending/suppress facility records.
Initial transit/access lane ran out of context before returning findings.
Captured Glimmingen fixed bus access, Bjursjon parking and distant Kopperods viadukt approach, Kurod/Skalbanksmuseet mid-stage access and live-check caveats.
Captured no active WST status, recurring wet/slippery/muddy reports, Bjursjon wayfinding risk, Stora Koperodssjon shelter field notes and dated facility reports.
Spatially screened protected areas and captured Bavean nedre, Kurods skalbankar, Koperodssjoarna water protection, no-Natura finding, fire, dog, camping, forestry and bathing-water rules/currentness.
